title: Finite-family Fourier estimator program
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $\mathcal F$ be a nonempty finite family of subsets of $\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$, and let $\varepsilon$ be a rational learning parameter with $0<\varepsilon\le 1/2$. The finite-family Fourier estimator program is the random-example learning program that uses the sample count prescribed for $\mathcal F$ and $\varepsilon$.
hypotheses_covered: $\mathcal F$ is a finite family of subsets of $\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$
